chunks: Whoever marries a woman while in his ihram, they shall be separated, and she will never be permissible for him.

key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِ: his state of ihram during hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman as the spouse in question

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying while in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning marriage contracted during the state of ihram. It establishes that such a marriage is invalid and requires permanent separation, showing the gravity of violating the restrictions of ihram.
